versos.grego: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἐπορεύθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς σάββασιν διὰ τῶν σπορίμων· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπείνασαν καὶ ἤρξαντο τίλλειν στάχυας καὶ ἐσθίειν.

controles.web: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
controles.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
controles.livre: Naquele tempo Jesus estava indo pelas plantações de cereais no sábado. Seus discípulos tinham fome, e começaram a arrancar espigas e a comer.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἰδόντες εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ οἱ μαθηταί σου ποιοῦσιν ὃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ποιεῖν ἐν σαββάτῳ.

controles.web: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
controles.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
controles.livre: Quando os fariseus viram, disseram-lhe: Eis que os teus discípulos fazem o que não é lícito fazer no sábado.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τί ἐποίησεν Δαυεὶδ ὅτε ἐπείνασεν καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;
controles.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
controles.livre: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não lestes o que Davi fez quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam,

versos.grego: πῶς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔφαγον, ὃ οὐκ ἐξὸν ἦν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν οὐδὲ τοῖς μετ’ αὐτοῦ, εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν μόνοις;

controles.web: how he entered into God’s house, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
controles.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
controles.livre: Como ele entrou na casa de Deus, e comeram os pães da proposição, que a ele não era lícito comer, nem também aos que com ele estavam, a não ser somente aos sacerdotes?

versos.grego: ἢ οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι τοῖς σάββασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τὸ σάββατον βεβηλοῦσιν καὶ ἀναίτιοί εἰσιν;

controles.web: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?
controles.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
controles.livre: Ou não lestes na Lei que, nos sábados, os sacerdotes no Templo profanam o sábado, sem se tornarem culpados?

versos.grego: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦ ἱεροῦ μεῖζόν ἐστιν ὧδε.

controles.web: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
controles.livre: Eu, porém, vos digo que o maior que o Templo está aqui.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἐγνώκειτε τί ἐστιν Ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν, οὐκ ἂν κατεδικάσατε τοὺς ἀναιτίους.

controles.web: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’you would not have condemned the guiltless.
controles.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
controles.livre: Mas se vós soubésseis o que significa: “Quero misericórdia, e não sacrifício”,  não condenaríeis os inocentes.

versos.grego: κύριος γάρ ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
controles.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
controles.livre: Porque o Filho do homem é Senhor do sábado.

versos.grego: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.
controles.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
controles.livre: E partindo dali, Jesus entrou na sinagoga deles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος χεῖρα ἔχων ξηράν· καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Εἰ ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεῦσαι; ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” that they might accuse him.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
controles.livre: E eis que havia ali um homem que tinha uma mão definhada; e eles, a fim de o acusarem, perguntaram-lhe: É lícito curar nos sábados?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τίς ἔσται ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἕξει πρόβατον ἕν, καὶ ἐὰν ἐμπέσῃ τοῦτο τοῖς σάββασιν εἰς βόθυνον, οὐχὶ κρατήσει αὐτὸ καὶ ἐγερεῖ;

controles.web: He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it, and lift it out?
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
controles.livre: E ele lhes respondeu: Qual de vós será a pessoa que, caso tenha uma ovelha, e se a tal cair em uma cova no sábado, não usará de sua força para a levantar?

versos.grego: πόσῳ οὖν διαφέρει ἄνθρωπος προβάτου. ὥστε ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν καλῶς ποιεῖν.

controles.web: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
controles.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
controles.livre: Ora, quanto mais vale um ser humano que uma ovelha! Assim, pois, é lícito fazer o bem nos sábados.

versos.grego: τότε λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ Ἔκτεινόν σου τὴν χεῖρα. καὶ ἐξέτεινεν, καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ὑγιὴς ὡς ἡ ἄλλη.

controles.web: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
controles.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
controles.livre: Então disse para aquele homem: Estende a tua mão.E ele a estendeu, e foi-lhe restaurada, sã como a outra.

versos.grego: ἐξελθόντες δὲ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συμβούλιον ἔλαβον κατ’ αὐτοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν.

controles.web: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
controles.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
controles.livre: Então os fariseus saíram e se reuniram para planejar contra ele, como o matariam.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς γνοὺς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν. καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς πάντας,

controles.web: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
controles.kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, sabendo disso, retirou-se dali. Muitos o seguiram, e ele curou todos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ φανερὸν αὐτὸν ποιήσωσιν·

controles.web: and commanded them that they should not make him known:
controles.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:
controles.livre: E ele lhes ordenava que não o tornassem conhecido;

versos.grego: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἡσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος

controles.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
controles.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
controles.livre: Para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta Isaías:

versos.grego: Ἰδοὺ ὁ παῖς μου ὃν ᾑρέτισα, ὁ ἀγαπητός μου ὃν εὐδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· θήσω τὸ Πνεῦμά μου ἐπ’ αὐτόν, καὶ κρίσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀπαγγελεῖ.

controles.web: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
controles.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
controles.livre: Eis aqui meu servo a quem escolhi, meu amado em quem minha alma se agrada; sobre ele porei o meu Espírito, e ele anunciará justiça às nações.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἐρίσει οὐδὲ κραυγάσει, οὐδὲ ἀκούσει τις ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
controles.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
controles.livre: Ele não fará brigas, nem gritará; ninguém ouvirá sua voz pelas ruas.

versos.grego: κάλαμον συντετριμμένον οὐ κατεάξει καὶ λίνον τυφόμενον οὐ σβέσει, ἕως ἂν ἐκβάλῃ εἰς νῖκος τὴν κρίσιν.

controles.web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
controles.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
controles.livre: A cana esmagada ele não despedaçará, o pavio que fumega ele não apagará, até que conduza a justiça à vitória.

versos.grego: καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.

controles.web: In his name, the nations will hope.”
controles.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
controles.livre: E em seu nome as nações esperarão.

versos.grego: Τότε προσηνέχθη αὐτῷ δαιμονιζόμενος τυφλὸς καὶ κωφός· καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτόν, ὥστε τὸν κωφὸν λαλεῖν καὶ βλέπειν.

controles.web: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
controles.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
controles.livre: Então lhe trouxeram um endemoninhado cego e mudo; e ele o curou de tal maneira que o mudo passou a falar e a ver.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξίσταντο πάντες οἱ ὄχλοι καὶ ἔλεγον Μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς Δαυείδ;

controles.web: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
controles.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
controles.livre: E todas as multidões se admiravam e diziam: Não é este o Filho de Davi?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες εἶπον Οὗτος οὐκ ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ Βεελζεβοὺλ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων.

controles.web: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
controles.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
controles.livre: Mas quando os fariseus ouviam isso, diziam: Ele não expulsa os demônios, a não ser por Belzebu, o chefe dos demônios.

versos.grego: εἰδὼς δὲ τὰς ἐνθυμήσεις αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πᾶσα βασιλεία μερισθεῖσα καθ’ ἑαυτῆς ἐρημοῦται, καὶ πᾶσα πόλις ἢ οἰκία μερισθεῖσα καθ’ ἑαυτῆς οὐ σταθήσεται.

controles.web: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
controles.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
controles.livre: Porém Jesus , entendendo os pensamentos deles, disse-lhes: Todo reino dividido contra si mesmo é destruído; e toda cidade ou casa dividida contra si mesma não permanecerá.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς τὸν Σατανᾶν ἐκβάλλει, ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν ἐμερίσθη· πῶς οὖν σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
controles.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
controles.livre: Ora, se Satanás expulsa a Satanás, contra si mesmo está dividido; como, pois, permanecerá o seu reino?

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν; διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ κριταὶ ἔσονται ὑμῶν.

controles.web: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
controles.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
controles.livre: E se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, então por quem vossos filhos  os expulsam? Portanto, eles mesmos serão vossos juízes.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἐν Πνεύματι Θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come upon you.
controles.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
controles.livre: Mas se eu pelo Espírito de Deus expulso os demônios, logo o Reino de Deus já chegou sobre vos.

versos.grego: ἢ πῶς δύναταί τις εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἁρπάσαι, ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον δήσῃ τὸν ἰσχυρόν, καὶ τότε τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ διαρπάσει;

controles.web: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
controles.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
controles.livre: Ou como pode alguém entrar na casa do valente, e saquear seus bens, sem primeiro amarrar ao valente? Depois disso saqueará sua casa.

versos.grego: ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ’ ἐμοῦ κατ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ’ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει.

controles.web: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
controles.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
controles.livre: Quem não é comigo é contra mim; e quem não ajunta comigo, espalha.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, πᾶσα ἁμαρτία καὶ βλασφημία ἀφεθήσεται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις, ἡ δὲ τοῦ Πνεύματος βλασφημία οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται.

controles.web: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
controles.livre: Por isso eu vos digo: todo pecado e blasfêmia serão perdoados aos seres humanos; mas a blasfêmia contra o Espírito não será perdoada.

versos.grego: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν εἴπῃ λόγον κατὰ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ· ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ κατὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου, οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ οὔτε ἐν τούτῳ τῷ αἰῶνι οὔτε ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι.

controles.web: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.
controles.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que falar palavra contra o Filho do homem lhe será perdoado; mas qualquer um que falar contra o Espírito Santo, não lhe será perdoado, nem na era presente, nem na futura.

versos.grego: Ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον καλὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ καλόν, ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον σαπρὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ σαπρόν· ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ καρποῦ τὸ δένδρον γινώσκεται.

controles.web: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
controles.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
controles.livre: Ou fazei a árvore boa, e seu fruto bom; ou fazei a árvore má, e seu fruto mau; pois pelo fruto se conhece a árvore.

versos.grego: γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, πῶς δύνασθε ἀγαθὰ λαλεῖν πονηροὶ ὄντες; ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ περισσεύματος τῆς καρδίας τὸ στόμα λαλεῖ.

controles.web: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
controles.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
controles.livre: Ninhada de víboras, como podeis vós falar boas coisas, sendo maus? Pois a boca fala do que o coração tem de sobra.

versos.grego: ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει ἀγαθά, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει πονηρά.

controles.web: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
controles.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
controles.livre: A pessoa boa tira coisas boas do bom tesouro, e a pessoa má tira coisas más do tesouro mau.

versos.grego: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶν ῥῆμα ἀργὸν ὃ λαλήσουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, ἀποδώσουσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ λόγον ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως·

controles.web: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
controles.livre: Eu, porém, vos digo que de toda palavra imprudente  que as pessoas falarem, dela prestarão contas no dia do juízo.

versos.grego: ἐκ γὰρ τῶν λόγων σου δικαιωθήσῃ, καὶ ἐκ τῶν λόγων σου καταδικασθήσῃ.

controles.web: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
controles.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
controles.livre: Porque por tuas palavras serás justificado,  e por tuas palavras serás condenado.

versos.grego: Τότε ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ τινες τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε, θέλομεν ἀπὸ σοῦ σημεῖον ἰδεῖν.

controles.web: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
controles.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
controles.livre: Então responderam-lhe uns dos escribas e dos fariseus, dizendo: Mestre, queremos ver de ti algum sinal.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ τοῦ προφήτου.

controles.web: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
controles.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
controles.livre: Mas ele lhes deu a seguinte resposta: Uma geração má e adúltera pede sinal; mas não lhe será dado, exceto o sinal do profeta Jonas.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἦν Ἰωνᾶς ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ τοῦ κήτους τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας, οὕτως ἔσται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τῆς γῆς τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας.

controles.web: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
controles.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
controles.livre: Porque assim como Jonas esteve três dias e três noites no ventre da baleia,  assim também o Filho do homem estará três dias e três noites no coração da terra.

versos.grego: ἄνδρες Νινευεῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν· ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε.

controles.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
controles.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
controles.livre: Os de Nínive se levantarão no Juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão; porque se arrependeram com a pregação de Jonas. E eis aqui quem é maior que Jonas.

versos.grego: βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτήν· ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε.

controles.web: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
controles.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
controles.livre: A rainha do sul se levantará no Juízo com esta geração, e a condenará; porque veio dos confins da terra para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão. E eis aqui quem é maior que Salomão.

versos.grego: Ὅταν δὲ τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, διέρχεται δι’ ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκει.

controles.web: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
controles.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
controles.livre: Quando o espírito imundo sai de alguém, anda por lugares secos buscando repouso, e não o acha.

versos.grego: τότε λέγει Εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ἐπιστρέψω ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον· καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει σχολάζοντα καὶ σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον.

controles.web: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
controles.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
controles.livre: Então diz: “Voltarei para minha casa de onde saí”. E quando chega, a encontra desocupada, varrida, e adornada.

versos.grego: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει μεθ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ· καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων. οὕτως ἔσται καὶ τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ πονηρᾷ.

controles.web: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
controles.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
controles.livre: Então vai, e toma consigo outros sete espíritos piores que ele; eles entram, e moram ali; e a última condição de tal pessoa se torna pior que a primeira. Assim também acontecerá com esta geração má.

versos.grego: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος τοῖς ὄχλοις ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἱστήκεισαν ἔξω ζητοῦντες αὐτῷ λαλῆσαι.

controles.web: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
controles.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
controles.livre: Enquanto ele ainda estava falando às multidões, eis que sua mãe e seus irmãos estavam fora, querendo falar com ele.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἔξω ἑστήκασιν ζητοῦντές σοι λαλῆσαι.

controles.web: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
controles.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
controles.livre: E alguém lhe disse: Eis que tua mãe e teus irmãos estão fora, querendo falar contigo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν τῷ λέγοντι αὐτῷ Τίς ἐστιν ἡ μήτηρ μου, καὶ τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ ἀδελφοί μου;

controles.web: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
controles.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
controles.livre: Porém ele disse em resposta ao que o avisou: Quem é minha mãe? E quem são meus irmãos?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου·

controles.web: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
controles.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
controles.livre: Então estendeu sua mão sobre seus discípulos, e disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos;

versos.grego: ὅστις γὰρ ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς, αὐτός μου ἀδελφὸς καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ ἐστίν.

controles.web: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
controles.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
controles.livre: Pois qualquer um que fizer a vontade do meu Pai, que está nos céus, esse é meu irmão, e irmã, e mãe.
